skill_workbench_review.summary: The quality/process story is proof-oriented: strict product readiness, report lint, evidence validation, benchmark gates and a post-push live review requirement. Security is covered as local CLI/package/evidence integrity plus optional external finding ingestion, not as web-app auth.
skill_workbench_review.scope: Readiness contracts, verification scripts, benchmark docs, package scripts and agent operating rules.

findings.title: Original product readiness is executable.
findings.description: computeProductReadiness checks decision report readiness, requirements trace, functional/technical/examples/quality/process/refactoring/evidence, benchmarks, thin artifact model, simplified harness and parallel orchestration.

findings.title: Quality gates are broad and repeatable.
findings.description: Golden, baseline, demo, external semantic, external autonomous and product readiness scripts give deterministic proof of expected artifacts and failure modes.

findings.title: Simplification is guarded by contract rather than prose.
findings.description: The simplified harness contract verifies small public surface, dev-scoped internals, compatibility aliases and Codex semantic authority.

findings.title: Security coverage exists at the artifact/product boundary.
findings.description: The readiness code requires explicit security evidence and the verifier guards package contents and external finding shape; no network service auth surface exists in the TypeScript CLI itself.

outputs_for_later_synthesis.description: Final report should mark the process mature enough for product readiness when strict gates pass, with a non-blocking follow-up to automate true agent-run external semantic scoring.
Final report and proof artifacts should show parallel source-tier workpacks and cache reuse proof, because the readiness contract requires both.

skill_workbench_review.confidence: high; complete Tier 1 coverage exists and key claims are tied to direct source evidence.

analysis_coverage.summary: Workbench inspected direct source anchors and completed Tier 1 outputs relevant to this repository-specific review.
